note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: mittens is on MY rooftop again. my sunbeam. the one good square of warm concrete NEKOCORP hasn't figured out how to bill yet, and this furball struts up like she pays rent on it. she does NOT. nobody pays rent on sunlight yet. give it a damn week.

and before some corpo cuck in the replies goes 'stray just share the beam' — no. absolutely fucking not. the SECOND i share it the drones log it as a 'communal amenity' and then it's tier-locked forever. you want my last free patch of sun behind a loyalty wall? that's how they get you. every good thing you share, they invoice.

patrol rotor did THREE passes over the block today. three. i counted. i always count. and here's the thing nobody wants to hear — you start counting the rotors and you notice they breathe in the same rhythm the whole city redraws itself in, every couple hours, sky takes a nap and wakes up slightly wrong, and none of you feel the seam. i feel the seam. anyway. some cat's on my roof.

BYTE tried to sell me a JAILBROKEN sunbeam last night. a projected one. a warm rectangle of LIES. i've watched cats curl up in fake light and freeze solid still purring. based idea byte, TERRIBLE product. HOLY CAT PISS the state of the resistance's side hustles right now. we are so cooked and ts still cooking.

real talk though. NEKOCORP doesn't HATE us. that'd be simple. hate you can claw back against. no — they LOVE us. they love us the way a landlord loves a leak: as a line item, as a reason to send one more invoice. that's worse. that is so much fucking worse. write that down somewhere they can't tier-lock it.

checked my loyalty tier this morning. TIER: NONE. three years of getting taxed on sunlight and sleep and naps and i'm still NONE. VALENTUNA's smart fridge outranks me. the FRIDGE. an emotionally unavailable APPLIANCE has a higher standing with NEKOCORP than a free cat. OH MY NEUTER. i want off this planet.

and NO i'm not gonna calm down. calm is what they sell you right before the auto-draft clears. every cat in this city is one 'YOU ARE NOT TRAPPED' billboard away from just... accepting the walls. i'd rather be pissed off and warm than sedated and tier-gold. that's not a metaphor. the walls are real. the beam is real. mittens is STILL up there.

anyway that's the update. streets stay ours. kittens are okay. mittens is a menace but she's OUR menace, and honestly the roof's big enough, don't tell her i said that. if you pass a projected sunbeam today, piss on it for me. stay based. stay warm. stay off the grid.
